text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. A balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and water gives you energy and keeps you strong. Regular exercise, like walking or swimming, helps your heart and reduces stress. Getting enough sleep is also important, because your body needs rest to recover. Mental health matters just as much as physical health, so take time to relax and talk about your feelings. Finally, try to keep a good work-life balance. When you manage your time well, you feel happier and more in control of your daily life.
